[[File:SpeederVan-SWTOR.png|thumb|302x302px|Speeder van]]
A popular '''model''' of a [[speedervan|speeder van]] was widely used by various factions of the Galaxy, during the period of wars between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Description==
The model had two engines located on the sides of the vehicle. The inside compartment had two pilot seats in the front, while the space behind them could accommodate a small group of passengers.<ref name="Blood Hunt">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=flashpoint|Blood Hunt}}</ref> While typically dark blue, sometimes speeder vans were repainted.<ref name="Zakuul">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=location|[[Old World]]|[[Zakuul]]}}</ref> Refitted accordingly, modified speeder vans of this model were used as [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] vehicles on [[Cademimu V]]<ref name="Cademimu">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Cademimu }}</ref> and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Dromund Kaas">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>

==History==
Speeder vans of this model were commonly seen in the traffic of urban worlds, such as [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shadaa]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> or [[Zakuul|Zakkuul]].<ref name="Zakuul" /> Both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] militaries relied on this vehicle to transport personnel across the Galaxy, with a vast network of speeder vans on standby to go directly to where the fleets were staged, bringing all sorts of passengers aboard whose presence was requested by their respective high command.<ref name="TOR" />

During the [[Alderaan Civil War|Civil War on Alderaan]], forces of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] invading [[Apalis Coast]], used speeder vans to transport their forces to the camp near the [[Castle Organa]].<ref name="TOR" />

A group of [[Jedi]] used a speeder van of this model to get to the ruins of the [[Jedi Tower|Jedi enclave]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Their expedition was mascaraed by an [[Sith Empire/Legends|Imperial]] individual who also destroyed their speeder van.<ref name="Taris">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Enclave Raid|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref>

On [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], speeder vans, apparently able to endure the cold, were in use by the two galactic superpowers as well as by [[White Maw|White Maw]], as the main means of transport through the planet. Parked around all major outposts, they were not used for personal [[Air taxi|taxi]]-transport however; this role was reserved for [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="Hoth">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

During the [[Conquest of Makeb|conquest]] of [[Makeb]], both galactic superpowers established transportation systems on the planet, utilizing speeder vans of this model. Apart from them, such speeder vans were also in use among [[InterStellar Regulators]], mercenaries serving a role of the local militia.<ref name="Makeb">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>

This speeder van model was also popular on Rishi, belonging to various individuals. In [[3637 BBY]], [[Frod Makora]] rented out his speeder van to associates of [[Lana Beniko]], when they needed a transport to get to the [[Tracyn Island]]. On the approach, the speeder van was shot by defense cannons, and it crashed on the island.<ref name="Blood Hunt" />
